tools.name: find_numbers
tools.description: Searches Exclusive Digits' phone numbers for sale and returns up to 20, ranked best first, each with price, location, what it spells, its patterns and its page link. Unknown pattern or industry codes are left out with a note. When nothing matches, the search widens on its own and the reply says how.

tools.name: get_number
tools.description: Return the current price, availability, location, named patterns and page link for one ten-digit US phone number.

tools.name: catalog_vocabulary
tools.description: List the pattern codes (with names and examples) and industry codes find_numbers accepts.

tools.name: how_buying_works
tools.description: How to buy, the one-time price, when the card is charged, what the buyer receives, transfer time to their carrier, refunds and support.
